name: Edward Hart
source: A mysterious man living cloistered in an eerie mansion on campus. His past as the world's most powerful vampire and his vast wealth of knowledge led to his appointment as Obscuary's captain, but he has little interest in his duties. Lately he is troubled by his aching joints.
